sections.shortTitle: N -W F P General Clauses Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE GENERAL CLAUSES
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE GENERAL CLAUSES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956
[Gazette of N.
-W'. F. P. Extraordinary, 19th April, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(1)/91/2349/2592,
dated 19-4-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province General Clauses (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of W.P. Act VI of 1956

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE GENERAL CLAUSES
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE GENERAL CLAUSES
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IX OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956
[Gazette of N.
-W'. F. P. Extraordinary, 19th April, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(1)/91/2349/2592,
dated 19-4-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of section 3 of
W.P. Act VI of 1956.--In the West Pakistan General Clauses Act, 1956 (W.P.
Act VI of 1956), the existing section 3 shall be renumbered as subsection (1)
of that section and after subsection (1), as so renumbered, the following new
subsection (2) shall be added, namely:
"(2) Government shall, by
Notification in the Official Gazette, or by any other means available, ensure
wide dissemination of all Circulars, Rules, Regulations and Instructions having
the effect of law. "
